sections.text: On iPhone: Open Settings, tap Apps, then tap Phone. Choose how to handle calls from numbers not saved in your contacts. Scroll to Screen Unknown Callers and select one of three options. Never: Calls from unsaved numbers ring like any other call. Ask Reason for Calling: Calls are screened. The caller is asked why they're calling before your phone rings. Silence: Calls are silenced and sent to voicemail. Call screening may incur standard calling and data rates. On iOS versions earlier than iOS 17, Live Voicemail must also be turned on to use call screening. While roaming, calls are not screened, regardless of settings. If you call emergency services, call screening turns off for 24 hours.
